correctness.rationale: With S occupied, closed NOR gives F(S)=R(S)^c x C(S)^c exactly; this implies F^3=F, no fixed configurations, and one empty/full orbit plus (2^a-2)(2^b-2)/2 complementary proper-rectangle pairs. An initial matrix with exact nonempty row/column supports A,B is counted by H(|A|,|B|) inclusion–exclusion, yielding every individual basin H(|A|,|B|)+H(a-|A|,b-|B|). The distinguished basin B=1+(2^b-1)^a+(2^a-1)^b-H(a,b) is >2^(ab-1). For uniformly random states, Bonferroni on events of an empty row and empty column gives epsilon ~ a 2^(-b)[1-(1-2^(-(a-1)))^b] uniformly 2<=a<=b with b→∞, including balanced boards and b/2^(a-1)→lambda. Independent literal cell-wise enumeration checked all states on 2x2,2x3,3x3,3x4 and verified periodicity, cycle counts, and main basins. All-size result follows analytically.
residual_risks: Closed self-inclusive neighborhoods essential; open-neighborhood NOR differs.
Uniformity requires a<=b and b→infinity, fair independent initial bits.
